issues.current: Administrator must be 21+ with a bachelor's degree, or a HS/GED plus four years' qualifying experience; orientation within 30 days; Rapback.
issues.correct: Those are only the education/experience-tier items under (E)(2)(g). The rule also requires (e) one year of paid work experience in specialized services (or four years caring for a family member with DD), and (f) one year of paid experience in each of supervising employees, developing/overseeing programs or services, and financial management. Also required: a birth certificate, SSN card and photo ID, and written English proficiency.
issues.evidence: OAC 5123-3-01(E)(2)(e)-(f): "One year of full-time (or equivalent part-time) paid work experience in the provision of specialized services" and "in: (i) Supervision of employees; (ii) Development, oversight, and/or supervision of programs or services; and (iii) Financial management of an organization."
issues.fix: Replace the administrator qualification text with the full OAC 5123-3-01(E)(2)(a)-(h) list. Add a note that an owner-operator must meet (e) and (f) as well as (g). Also add (E)(3): the operator must designate in writing a staff member to act in the administrator's absence.
